about_the_game:
For video creators and streamers
KIMIDORI SOFT permits monetization through partner programs using KIMIDORI SOFT games.


Feeling lonely during long hours at your PC? Ease that solitude with this unique desktop accessory. It combines a calming mini-game themed around purifying lucky coins with a practical Pomodoro timer. Experience a gentle connection with up to 100 players and bring a peaceful ambiance to your desktop.

Overview
Press Space or Right-Click to purify a lucky 5-yen coin, imbue it with your hopes, and toss it towards the central dish. Feel the direction and strength of the passing wind as you adjust your aim and power—a simple yet deep, tranquil challenge.

In Multiplayer, cooperate with others to gather Blessing Points. These points reset when the last player leaves the session.
In Singleplayer, your progress, including the permanent placement of your coins, is saved.

Experience the changing hues and sounds from morning to night. Take a moment's break from your work, test your fortune for the day, and purify a coin to toss into the serene pond.

Features & Characteristics

● Purify, Toss, and Seek Blessings
Purify a 5-yen coin and gently toss it towards the central dish. Successfully landing it on the dish grants you Blessing Points. As you accumulate these points, the scenery on your screen becomes progressively more vibrant and beautiful.

● Your History, Etched into the Pond
Each 5-yen coin you toss remains exactly where it lands, never disappearing. Whether you succeed or miss, your actions are etched into the pond's landscape. As you play, the pond fills with your tossed coins, gradually creating a scene rich with history and presence, much like a real-world location where countless wishes have gathered over time. Enjoy the view of a pond that tells your unique story.

● A World That Flows with Time, Changing Expressions
Watch the scenery shift from the light of dawn to the moonlit night. The delicate sounds of nature, like birdsong and insect calls, change with the time of day, adding depth to the atmosphere. You can lock the time to your favorite period, enjoy a faster cycle of day and night, or sync it with your actual PC clock. Tailor the flow of time to suit your mood.

● Gentle Communication Through Stamps
Engage in lighthearted, subtle communication using adorable stamps. Cheer others on, offer a quiet word of encouragement, or simply share a feeling with those sharing the same virtual space and moment. Feel the gentle presence of others around you.

● Find Your Rhythm: Pomodoro Timer
Includes a standard Pomodoro Timer to help structure your work and rest periods. Set your focus intervals, short breaks, long breaks, and the frequency of long breaks. The mini-game serves as a perfect, relaxing activity during your break times.

● Shared Space: Multiplayer
Up to 100 players can join the same session simultaneously. Enjoy the experience playing alone, setting up a private match with friends, or joining a public space.

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia Geforce GTX 650 or AMD Radeon HD 7750
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
